class.name: FmodAudioPreviewProperty
class.brief_description: Custom property editor control for previewing FMOD audio streams in the editor.
class.description: Displays an audio waveform, playback controls, a position indicator, and time labels for [FmodAudioStream] in the inspector. Clicking the waveform seeks playback. Shares waveform cache data with the [code]stream[/code] property previews on [FmodAudioStreamPlayer], [FmodAudioStreamPlayer2D], and [FmodAudioStreamPlayer3D]. Waveform generation is deferred to a later main-thread call. Inspector audition uses an internal [FmodAudioStreamPlayer] routed to [code]Master[/code]. In independent bus mode, its levels appear in the visible FMOD Audio Dock. The Dock does not display levels from a separate running game process.

method.name: set_stream
method.description: Sets the [FmodAudioStream] to preview, stops any current audition, and requests its waveform from the shared cache.
